what: research-queue-dispatch.yml's 'Check for an in-flight receipt PR' step skips 'Land the liveness receipt' whenever ANY receipt PR is open, with no age or mergeability bound. Receipt PR #17016 (opened 2026-10-07, conflicted, no checks) sat open ~50h, so every dispatcher run since skipped the receipt (observed on run 37990624139) and research-queue-dispatch-liveness went red repo-wide at 48.23h while result batches still landed (#17300 merged 2026-10-09T21:38Z). The manager closed #17016 at ~23:02Z 2026-10-09 as a stopgap. Lane task (Tier-1, CI): treat a receipt PR that is dirty/conflicted or older than ~3h as dead (close it with a comment) instead of blocking on it; add a self-test.
